ROW 2 (bottom) - A DISTANT CLOAKED FIGURE RUNNING ACROSS ROOFTOPS, 4 frames of a looping bounding run, travelling to the RIGHT, side view, facing right. The same character as the attached character reference: tall and gaunt, a pale grey-white face with smooth skin where the eyes should be (he has no eyes), short black hair, dark charcoal armour, and a long tattered black cloak streaming far out behind him to the left. Frame 2: airborne mid-leap, legs stretched wide, cloak flying out behind. Frame 3: top of the leap, knees tucked, the blue ribbon fluttering. Frame 4: landing on the leading foot, ready to push off again (flows back into frame 1). The figure is the same height in all four frames. Paint him as a far-background figure: simplified shapes, a strong dark silhouette, cool dusk shading, and a thin warm orange rim light from the setting sun along his right edge.

STYLE for everything: hand-drawn HD 2D game art in the spirit of Streets of Rage 4, with confident dark ink outlines, clean cel shading in 2-3 tone steps, and light from the upper left. Not pixel art, not 3D, not photoreal. No pink, magenta or purple anywhere on the tiles or the figure, so the background can be cut out cleanly.
